campaign.title: Quadratic completion of the signed short twisted-divisor core

resource_policy.literature_policy: Search primary sources for two-dimensional van der Corput, quadratic completion, theta/Voronoi, or character-twisted reciprocal-strip estimates; import nothing without exact hypothesis and normalization checks.

frozen_target.question: Does exact additive completion of chi_4(n/h)1_(h|n), followed by a coefficient-preserving radial B-process, prove square-root cancellation in the length-R high-shell twisted-divisor sum, or does the dual reciprocal strip rigorously return to an equivalent-hard kernel?
frozen_target.reference_formula: P_J=sum_(A<=n<=B)e(sqrt(Xn)) sum_(h|n,R/4<h<=R/2,n/h odd) chi_4(n/h) Omega_X^*(n,h), where Y=R^2 asymp sqrt(X), |J|<=R, and the unweighted target is X^epsilon sqrt(R).
quantities: radial B-process stationary and nonstationary terms
dual strip phase Xh/r and exact Hessian determinant
chi_4 character under the r-to-s change
raw dual target R before the R^(-1/2) stationary normalization
actual profiles, height floors, hard top, and stars

completion_criteria: The modulo-4h projector is derived with its exact constant, sign, and character convention.
The finite radial B-process or Poisson transform includes endpoint, nonstationary, stationary, and equality-star terms with exact normalization.
The dual strip, its support thickness, character, amplitude, and raw R target are derived without termwise absolute values.
The exact Hessian and all modulo-one or character resonances are audited, especially at X=K^4.
A raw dual O_epsilon(X^epsilon R) estimate is proved, or a strict obstruction/equivalence return is isolated.
Any source theorem is checked against the thin sheared strip, X-dependent actual symbol, character, endpoints, and parameter ranges.
A clean statement-only rederivation and an independent hostile/source gate exist.
No lower-shell, alpha, M9-M1, M9, or exponent promotion occurs without its own proof.

tasks.target: Derive the exact additive completion and radial B-process, then prove the raw two-dimensional dual-strip O(R X^epsilon) estimate or isolate the first sharp arithmetic obstruction.
required_output: two-dimensional signed estimate or sharp return obstruction

tasks.target: Using only the Round-59 packet, independently derive the projector, stationary dual strip, normalization, Hessian, and best rigorously justified capacity.
Hostilely audit the B-process, two-dimensional Hessian argument, rational/quarter-frequency resonances, actual-symbol seams, and applicability of primary-source quadratic or reciprocal-sum theorems.

review_seams.requirement: Check the -i/(2h) constant and chi_4(-r) sign by exact finite Fourier inversion.
Keep the e(plus/minus 1/8) factor, curvature amplitude, moving stationary cone, endpoints, nonstationary tails, and stars.
A nonzero real Hessian determinant is not by itself a lattice cancellation theorem; audit integer and quarter-frequency coherence with chi_4 retained.
The stationary prefactor is of order R^(-1/2), so the raw R-by-R dual strip must be O(X^epsilon R), not merely bounded termwise.
The blind proof sees only the Round-59 packet and brief.
